messages:
maya: quick q — onboarding wants per-route SLOs surfaced in Console with notification knobs. main concern: alert spam when routes are noisy during deploys. any strong opinions on defaults?
liam: agree we need per-route but default thresholds should be conservative. maybe default to page for P0 only, email for P1, and in-console banner for P2.
sofia: can we make noise suppression automatic around rollouts? like detect deploy window + spike tolerance.
devon: +1 to rollout-awareness. also want a mute-until-stable toggle on the route page for devs. click, specify window, and SLO alerts suppressed (still logged).
maya: we heard product ask for user-facing SLOs (customers see %s) too — separate from alerting UX. keep that display-only by default.
liam: proposal: three-layer surface in Console: 1) SLO display (read-only), 2) Alert config (threshold, severity, notify targets), 3) Noise controls (auto-snooze, deploy windows, anomaly backoff).
sofia: what about smart thresholds? e.g., adaptive baseline using 7d p50/p95 and only alert when current exceeds baseline + delta. reduces noisy alerts for seasonal traffic.
devon: curious about complexity. adaptive sounds great but ops teams want deterministic thresholds they can audit. maybe make adaptive opt-in per-team, and expose the algorithm + sample window.
liam: agree. UI copy should say "Adaptive mode uses historical baseline (7d) — enable to reduce false positives". default OFF.
maya: notification targets — should be per-route and inherit org-level by default. and allow adding webhook, slack channel, pager.
sofia: small UX ask — when creating a new route show recommended thresholds based on historical latency/error distribution with a suggested severity. One-click apply.
devon: sample config snippet for how Console would expose it: ```json
{
  "route": "/gen/v1/stream",
  "slo": {"objective_pct":99.5, "window":"30d"},
  "alerting": {"threshold":"p95>800ms","severity":"P1","notify":["#team-gen","oncall@company.com"]},
  "noise_control": {"deploy_protection":true,"auto_snooze_minutes":30}
}
```
maya: love the sample. question: how granular should rollouts be? per-route vs per-deployment-id vs per-model-variant?
liam: prefer per-deployment-id for short-lived spikes, but show aggregated route-level SLOs and let users drill into deployment instances.
sofia: monitoring cost note — more granularity -> more metrics retention/queries. need to add an estimate in Console when you toggle high-res telemetry.
devon: ops/pager teams asked for grouping rules to reduce noise: aggregate similar alerts for N min before paging. should be configurable per severity.
maya: actionable next steps: 1) eng-platform will mock Console screens for 3-layer model, 2) eng-sre to draft default thresholds and grouping rules, 3) eng-runtime to add rollout metadata into metrics pipeline so Console can detect deploy windows.
sofia: +1. I'll start a quick Figma and share by EOD.
liam: i'll draft alerting default doc and put PR up to platform repo.
sofia: slo-bot: create ticket for "Console SLO - adaptive suggestions + noise controls"
slo-bot: Created ticket #PLAT-4821: "Console SLO - adaptive suggestions + noise controls" assigned to eng-platform, priority P2. :white_check_mark:
maya: thanks — can we sync on Monday to align with product? :calendar:
